::: {.book-summary} ## Book Summary Insight 1 Kings records Solomon's reign, the construction of the Temple, and the division of Israel into two kingdoms. The book teaches that covenant faithfulness leads to blessing, while idolatry brings decline and judgment. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 1
1 Kings 1:30
Solomon shall reign after me
### Why This Verse Succession settled ### Chapter Insight This chapter records the transition of power from David to Solomon. The key verse highlights God's preservation of His covenant plan through Solomon's succession. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 2
1 Kings 2:3
Keep the charge of the LORD
### Why This Verse David's final counsel ### Chapter Insight This chapter contains David's final instructions and Solomon's consolidation of the kingdom. The key verse emphasizes obedience to God's law as the foundation of successful leadership. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 3
1 Kings 3:9
Give thy servant an understanding heart
### Why This Verse Solomon's famous request ### Chapter Insight This chapter recounts Solomon's request for wisdom. The key verse demonstrates that true leadership begins with dependence upon God. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 4
1 Kings 4:29
God gave Solomon wisdom
### Why This Verse Summary of Solomon's gift ### Chapter Insight This chapter describes Solomon's administration and prosperity. The key verse highlights the peace and abundance that accompanied wise rule. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 5
1 Kings 5:5
I purpose to build a house unto the LORD
### Why This Verse Temple project begins ### Chapter Insight This chapter records preparations for building the Temple. The key verse emphasizes God's faithfulness in fulfilling His promises to David. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 6
1 Kings 6:7
No hammer heard in the temple
### Why This Verse Memorable temple detail ### Chapter Insight This chapter details the construction of the Temple. The key verse underscores God's desire to dwell among His covenant people. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 7
1 Kings 7:51
All the work was finished
### Why This Verse Temple completion ### Chapter Insight This chapter describes the completion of Solomon's palace and Temple furnishings. The key verse highlights the excellence devoted to God's house. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 8
1 Kings 8:27
Will God indeed dwell on the earth?
### Why This Verse Solomon's temple prayer ### Chapter Insight This chapter records the dedication of the Temple. The key verse celebrates God's presence dwelling among His people while recognizing His infinite greatness. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 9
1 Kings 9:3
My eyes and My heart shall be there perpetually
### Why This Verse God's response ### Chapter Insight This chapter recounts God's appearance to Solomon after the Temple's completion. The key verse emphasizes that covenant blessing depends upon continued obedience. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 10
1 Kings 10:9
Blessed be the LORD thy God
### Why This Verse Queen of Sheba's testimony ### Chapter Insight This chapter records the visit of the Queen of Sheba. The key verse demonstrates how God's blessing upon Solomon became a witness to the nations. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 11
1 Kings 11:4
His heart was not fully devoted
### Why This Verse Solomon's decline ### Chapter Insight This chapter describes Solomon's spiritual decline through idolatry. The key verse reveals the danger of divided devotion to God. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 12
1 Kings 12:16
What portion have we in David?
### Why This Verse Division of the kingdom ### Chapter Insight This chapter records the division of the kingdom under Rehoboam. The key verse illustrates how pride and poor counsel can fracture unity. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 13
1 Kings 13:21
Thou hast disobeyed the LORD
### Why This Verse Judgment on the prophet ### Chapter Insight This chapter recounts the ministry of the man of God from Judah. The key verse emphasizes complete obedience to God's word. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 14
1 Kings 14:8
David followed Me with all his heart
### Why This Verse David as standard ### Chapter Insight This chapter records judgment upon Jeroboam and Rehoboam. The key verse highlights the consequences of persistent sin and idolatry. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 15
1 Kings 15:11
Asa did what was right
### Why This Verse Righteous king summary ### Chapter Insight This chapter contrasts faithful and unfaithful kings. The key verse commends Asa's wholehearted devotion to God. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 16
1 Kings 16:30
Ahab did evil above all before him
### Why This Verse Introduction to Ahab ### Chapter Insight This chapter describes political instability and increasing wickedness in Israel. The key verse introduces Ahab as one of Israel's most evil kings. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 17
1 Kings 17:1
There shall not be dew nor rain
### Why This Verse Elijah's first appearance ### Chapter Insight This chapter begins Elijah's ministry. The key verse demonstrates God's power to provide during times of judgment and scarcity. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 18
1 Kings 18:21
How long halt ye between two opinions?
### Why This Verse Elijah at Carmel ### Chapter Insight This chapter records Elijah's confrontation with the prophets of Baal on Mount Carmel. The key verse calls God's people to wholehearted allegiance to Him alone. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 19
1 Kings 19:12
A still small voice
### Why This Verse One of the most famous OT verses ### Chapter Insight This chapter recounts Elijah's discouragement and God's restoration of him. The key verse reveals God's presence through a gentle whisper rather than dramatic displays alone. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 20
1 Kings 20:11
Let not him that girds on boast
### Why This Verse Famous proverb-like statement ### Chapter Insight This chapter describes God's victories over Syria through Ahab. The key verse demonstrates that God's glory is His ultimate purpose. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 21
1 Kings 21:25
None like Ahab sold himself to do evil
### Why This Verse Ahab's legacy ### Chapter Insight This chapter records Ahab's seizure of Naboth's vineyard. The key verse highlights God's commitment to justice against abuse of power. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 22
1 Kings 22:14
What the LORD says unto me, that will I speak
### Why This Verse Micaiah's integrity ### Chapter Insight This chapter recounts Micaiah's prophecy and Ahab's death. The key verse demonstrates that God's word is certain even when rejected. :::
